"""RoboPaint trajectory for the limited-mode episode. All poses are brush-tip poses."""
import sys, time, json
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)  # wxyz, brush vertical


def lin_pose_path(start, end, speed=0.10, hz=20):
    """Return 20 Hz ee-pose targets, including end, with linear xyz and fixed orientation."""
    a, b = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:3]-a[:3]) * hz / speed)))
    return np.stack([np.r_[a[:3] + (b[:3]-a[:3]) * i/n, b[3:]] for i in range(1,n+1)])


def run_path(r, start, end, speed=0.10, cameras=None, note=''):
    p = lin_pose_path(start, end, speed)
    return r.submit('ee_pose', p, dt=1/20, cameras=cameras, video='frames', note=note)


def paper_pose(x_mm, y_mm, z, origin=(0.0135925, 0.1135925)):
    """Paper X points robot right (-world y), paper Y points toward robot (-world x)."""
    ox, oy = origin
    return np.array([ox-y_mm/1000, oy-x_mm/1000, z, *DOWN])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    r = Robot()
    print(json.dumps({'budget': r.status(), 'start': r.get_obs(video='none').meta['proprio']['now']}, indent=2))

+PAPER_ORIGIN_Y = 0.1135925  # world y, left edge of main sheet (+y)
+PAPER_Z = 0.020

+def paper_pose(x_mm, y_mm, z):
+    """Map sheet millimetres to world pose. Paper X is robot-right; Y is toward robot."""
+    return np.array([
+        PAPER_ORIGIN_X - y_mm / 1000.0,
+        PAPER_ORIGIN_Y - x_mm / 1000.0,
+        float(z),
+        *DOWN,
+    ])
+
+
+def pixel_pose(u, v, z):
+    """Map a target-image pixel center to a main-sheet tip pose."""
+    return paper_pose((float(u) + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX,
+                      (float(v) + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX, z)
+
+
+def line_poses(start, end, speed=0.08):
+    """20 Hz straight-line ee targets, with each increment at `speed`."""
+    a, b = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b[:3] - a[:3]) * HZ / speed)))
+    return np.stack([
+        np.r_[a[:3] + (b[:3] - a[:3]) * (i / n), b[3:]]
+        for i in range(1, n + 1)
+    ])
+
+
+def move_tip(r, start, end, speed=0.08, note=""):
+    return r.submit("ee_pose", line_poses(start, end, speed), dt=1 / HZ,
+                    video="both", note=note)
+
+
+def curve_rows(pixel_points, z_profile, speed=0.025):
+    """Build smooth, constant-speed ee targets from pixel-space keypoints.
+
+    z_profile contains (keypoint_index, tip_z) pairs. PCHIP keeps both the
+    centerline and the pressure ramp smooth without overshooting the exemplar.
+    """
+    p = np.asarray(pixel_points, dtype=float)
+    seg = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p, axis=0), axis=1)
+    s = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(seg)]
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil((s[-1] * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0) / (speed / HZ))))
+    samples = np.linspace(0.0, s[-1], n + 1)
+    u = PchipInterpolator(s, p[:, 0])(samples)
+    v = PchipInterpolator(s, p[:, 1])(samples)
+    zs = np.array([z for _, z in z_profile], dtype=float)
+    ss = np.array([s[i] for i, _ in z_profile], dtype=float)
+    z = PchipInterpolator(ss, zs)(samples)
+    return np.stack([pixel_pose(x, y, zz) for x, y, zz in zip(u, v, z)])
